title: obra/superpowers
title_zh: 超级力量：编程代理的软件开发方法论

paragraphs.en: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
paragraphs.zh: 一套行之有效的智能体技能框架与软件开发方法论。

paragraphs.en: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.
paragraphs.zh: Superpowers 是一套完整的软件开发方法论，专为你的智能体设计，它构建在一组可组合的技能之上，并附带一些初始指令，确保你的智能体会使用这些技能。

paragraphs.en: It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it doesn't just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do.
paragraphs.zh: 它从你启动编码智能体的那一刻就开始了。 一旦它发现你在构建某个东西，它并不会直接跳进去尝试写代码。 相反，它会退后一步，询问你真正想要做的是什么。

sents.en: It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent.
sents.zh: 它从你启动编码智能体的那一刻就开始了。

sents.en: As soon as it sees that you're building something, it doesn't just jump into trying to write code.
sents.zh: 一旦它发现你在构建某个东西，它并不会直接跳进去尝试写代码。

sents.en: Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do.
sents.zh: 相反，它会退后一步，询问你真正想要做的是什么。

paragraphs.en: Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦它从对话中梳理出规范，就会将其分块展示给你，每块都足够短小，便于你真正阅读和消化。

paragraphs.en: After you've signed off on the design, your agent puts together an implementation plan that's clear enough for an enthusiastic junior engineer with poor taste, no judgement, no project context, and an aversion to testing to follow. It emphasizes true red/green TDD, YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It), and DRY.
paragraphs.zh: 在你签字确认设计之后，你的智能体会制定一份实现计划，这份计划要清晰到足以让一名热情但品味差、缺乏判断力、不了解项目背景且厌恶测试的初级工程师照着执行。 它强调真正的红/绿测试驱动开发（TDD）、YAGNI（你不会需要它）原则和 DRY 原则。

sents.en: After you've signed off on the design, your agent puts together an implementation plan that's clear enough for an enthusiastic junior engineer with poor taste, no judgement, no project context, and an aversion to testing to follow.
sents.zh: 在你签字确认设计之后，你的智能体会制定一份实现计划，这份计划要清晰到足以让一名热情但品味差、缺乏判断力、不了解项目背景且厌恶测试的初级工程师照着执行。

sents.en: It emphasizes true red/green TDD, YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It), and DRY.
sents.zh: 它强调真正的红/绿测试驱动开发（TDD）、YAGNI（你不会需要它）原则和 DRY 原则。

paragraphs.en: Next up, once you say "go", it launches a subagent-driven-development process, having agents work through each engineering task, inspecting and reviewing their work, and continuing forward. It's not uncommon for your agent to work autonomously for a couple hours at a time without deviating from the plan you put together.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，一旦你说「开始」，它就会启动一个由子智能体驱动的开发流程，让智能体逐项完成每个工程任务，检查并审查它们的工作，然后继续推进。 你的智能体一次自主连续工作几个小时而不偏离你制定的计划，这种情况并不少见。

sents.en: Next up, once you say "go", it launches a subagent-driven-development process, having agents work through each engineering task, inspecting and reviewing their work, and continuing forward.
sents.zh: 接下来，一旦你说「开始」，它就会启动一个由子智能体驱动的开发流程，让智能体逐项完成每个工程任务，检查并审查它们的工作，然后继续推进。

sents.en: It's not uncommon for your agent to work autonomously for a couple hours at a time without deviating from the plan you put together.
sents.zh: 你的智能体一次自主连续工作几个小时而不偏离你制定的计划，这种情况并不少见。

paragraphs.en: There's a bunch more to it, but that's the core of the system. And because the skills trigger automatically, you don't need to do anything special. Your coding agent just has Superpowers.
paragraphs.zh: 还有更多细节，但这些就是系统的核心。 而且由于技能会自动触发，你不需要做任何特殊操作。 你的智能体就是拥有超能力。

sents.en: There's a bunch more to it, but that's the core of the system.
sents.zh: 还有更多细节，但这些就是系统的核心。

sents.zh: 你的智能体就是拥有超能力。

paragraphs.en: Install the plugin from Anthropic's official marketplace:
paragraphs.zh: 从 Anthropic 官方市场安装该插件：

paragraphs.en: /plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official Superpowers Marketplace The Superpowers marketplace provides Superpowers and some other related plugins for Claude Code.
paragraphs.zh: /plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official Superpowers 市场 Superpowers 市场为 Claude Code 提供 Superpowers 以及其他一些相关插件。

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace Install the plugin from this marketplace:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace 从此市场安装插件：

paragraphs.en: /plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace Antigravity Install Superpowers as a plugin from this repository:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace Antigravity 从此仓库将 Superpowers 作为插件安装：

paragraphs.en: agy plugin install https://github.com/obra/superpowers Antigravity lists each installed skill's description, and the description of the using-superpowers skill prompts the model to load that skill at the start of a conversation. Reinstall with the same command to update.

paragraphs.en: Install Superpowers as a Pi package from this repository:
paragraphs.zh: 从这个仓库安装 Superpowers 作为 Pi 软件包：

paragraphs.en: pi install git:github.com/obra/superpowers For local development, run Pi with this checkout loaded as a temporary package:
paragraphs.zh: pi install git:github.com/obra/superpowers 对于本地开发，请在运行 Pi 时将此检出的代码作为临时包加载：

paragraphs.en: pi -e /path/to/superpowers The Pi package loads the Superpowers skills and a small extension that injects the using-superpowers bootstrap at session startup and again after compaction. Pi has native skills, so no compatibility Skill tool is required. Subagent and task-list tools remain optional Pi companion packages.
paragraphs.zh: pi -e /path/to/superpowers Pi 包会加载 Superpowers 技能以及一个小扩展，该扩展会在会话启动时注入 using-superpowers 引导内容，并在压缩后再次注入。 Pi 原生支持技能，因此不需要兼容性的 Skill 工具。 子智能体与任务列表工具仍是可选的 Pi 配套包。

paragraphs.en: hermes plugins install obra/superpowers --enable Restart any active Hermes sessions after installing. Note: Hermes has no post-compaction hook, so a very long session that compacts over its first turn loses the bootstrap — start a fresh session if skills stop triggering.

paragraphs.en: Superpowers is available as a native Muse plugin — same repo, same skills, all harnesses. The using-superpowers bootstrap is injected via the native SessionStart hook alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Pi, and the rest — no per-session opt-in.
paragraphs.zh: Superpowers 现已作为原生 Muse 插件提供——同一仓库、同样的技能、全部测试框架。 using-superpowers 引导流程通过原生 SessionStart 钩子注入，与 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini、Pi 等其他工具并列——无需每次会话手动启用。

paragraphs.en: muse plugins install ./ muse plugins approve superpowers Or clone and install:
paragraphs.zh: muse plugins install ./ muse plugins approve superpowers 或者克隆并安装：

paragraphs.en: git clone https://github.com/obra/superpowers.git muse plugins install ./superpowers muse plugins approve superpowers Update later:

paragraphs.en: muse plugins update superpowers Restart any active Muse sessions after installing so the SessionStart hook takes effect — skills are active immediately, hooks require approval on first install. To verify, start a fresh session and send Let's make a react todo list — a working install auto-triggers brainstorming before any code is written. Version is tracked in .version-bump.json so scripts/bump-version.sh keeps it in sync.
paragraphs.zh: muse 插件更新完成之后，重启所有正在进行的 Muse 会话，以使 SessionStart 钩子生效——技能会立即生效，而钩子在首次安装时需要批准。 如需验证，请开启一个全新会话并发送「Let's make a react todo list」——安装正常时会自动在任何代码编写之前触发头脑风暴。 版本号记录在 .version-bump.json 中，因此 scripts/bump-version.sh 可以保持其同步。

paragraphs.en: brainstorming - Activates before building anything. Draws out what you actually want, and why, through questions that get you describing it, then plays its understanding back for correction. Small changes get agreed in chat; projects get a written design document a builder could plan from.
paragraphs.zh: 头脑风暴——在构建任何东西之前启动。 通过提问引导你描述出你真正想要什么以及为什么，然后将其理解复述出来供你纠正。 小改动在聊天中达成一致；项目则会形成一份书面的设计文档，让构建者可以据此进行规划。

paragraphs.en: using-git-worktrees - Activates after design approval. Creates isolated workspace on new branch, runs project setup, verifies clean test baseline.
paragraphs.zh: using-git-worktrees — 在设计获批后激活。 在新分支上创建隔离的工作区，运行项目初始化，并验证测试基线是干净的。

paragraphs.en: writing-plans - Activates with approved design. Breaks work into bite-sized tasks (2-5 minutes each). Every task has exact file paths, complete code, verification steps.
paragraphs.zh: writing-plans - 在设计获批后启用。 将工作拆分成小任务（每个 2-5 分钟）。 每个任务都包含确切的文件路径、完整代码和验证步骤。

paragraphs.en: subagent-driven-development or executing-plans - Activates with plan. Either dispatches a fresh subagent per task with a review after each (most thorough), or implements every task inline in the current session with one fresh review of the whole branch at the end (cheapest).
paragraphs.zh: subagent-driven-development（子智能体驱动开发）或 executing-plans（执行计划）— 有计划时激活。 它要么为每个任务派发一个全新的子智能体，并在每个任务之后进行一次审查（最彻底），要么在当前会话中直接实现每个任务，并在最后对整个分支进行一次全新的审查（成本最低）。

sents.en: subagent-driven-development or executing-plans - Activates with plan.

sents.en: Either dispatches a fresh subagent per task with a review after each (most thorough), or implements every task inline in the current session with one fresh review of the whole branch at the end (cheapest).

paragraphs.en: test-driven-development - Activates during implementation. Enforces RED-GREEN-REFACTOR: write failing test, watch it fail, write minimal code, watch it pass, commit. Deletes code written before tests.
paragraphs.zh: 测试驱动开发 — 在实现过程中激活。 强制执行 RED-GREEN-REFACTOR（红-绿-重构）流程：先写失败的测试，观察其失败，编写最小实现代码，观察其通过，然后提交。 删除在测试之前编写的代码。

paragraphs.en: Sometimes a session misbehaves: a skill fires when it shouldn't, stays silent when it should, or the agent ignores its plan, repeats work, or burns more tokens than you'd expect. Ask your coding agent to "figure out what went wrong with superpowers in this session" and it will invoke the diagnosing-superpowers skill. To examine an earlier session, name it: "figure out what went wrong with superpowers in session <id> ".
paragraphs.zh: 有时会话会出现异常：某个技能在不该触发时触发了，在该触发时却保持沉默，或者智能体无视其计划、重复做功、或消耗的 token 比你预期的更多。 让你的编码智能体「弄清楚本次会话中 superpowers 出了什么问题」，它就会调用 diagnosing-superpowers 技能。 要检查较早的会话，请指明它：「弄清楚会话 <id> 中 superpowers 出了什么问题」。

paragraphs.en: The skill reads the session transcript, reports what happened with line-level evidence, and, if you want, packages a scrubbed bundle for a bug report.
paragraphs.zh: 该技能会读取会话记录，逐行给出证据并报告发生了什么；如果需要，还可以打包一份经过清理的捆绑文件，用于提交错误报告。

paragraphs.en: The general contribution process for Superpowers is below. Keep in mind that we don't generally accept contributions of new skills and that any updates to skills must work across all of the coding agents we support. We also don't accept agent-written PRs that fix issues filed by someone else unless a maintainer asked for one, even when you hit the same problem; add your report to the existing issue instead.
paragraphs.zh: Superpowers 的总体贡献流程如下。 请注意，我们一般不接受新技能的贡献，并且对技能的任何更新都必须在我们支持的所有编码智能体上都能正常工作。 我们也不接受由智能体撰写的、修复他人所提交议题的 PR，除非维护者提出要求；即使你遇到了同样的问题，也请把你的报告添加到已有的 issue 中。

paragraphs.en: Because skills and plugins don't provide any feedback to creators, we have no idea how many of you are using Superpowers. By default, the Prime Radiant logo on brainstorming's optional visual companion feature is loaded from our website. It includes the version of Superpowers in use. It does not include any details about your project, prompt, or coding agent. We don't see your clicks or anything about what you're building. This helps us have a rough idea of how many folks are using Superpowers and which version of Superpowers they're using. It's 100% optional. To disable this, set the environment variable SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY to any true value. Superpowers also honors Claude Code's DISABLE_TELEMETRY and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC opt-outs.
paragraphs.zh: 由于技能和插件不会向创建者提供任何反馈，我们无从得知你们当中有多少人在使用 Superpowers。 默认情况下，头脑风暴的可选可视化伴随功能中的 Prime Radiant 标志是从我们的网站加载的。 其中包含正在使用的 Superpowers 版本。 它不包含关于你的项目、提示词或编码智能体的任何细节。 我们看不到你的点击，也看不到你正在构建的内容的任何信息。 这有助于我们大致了解有多少人在使用 Superpowers 以及他们使用的是哪个版本。此功能 100% 可选。 要禁用此功能，请将环境变量 SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY 设置为任何真值。 Superpowers 同样遵循 Claude Code 的 DISABLE_TELEMETRY 和 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC 退出选项。
